I believe in the power of collaboration, continuous learning, and the pursuit of excellence in every line of code I write.

about.title: About Me
about.description: Accomplished IT professional with 10 years of experience in corporate software engineering, specializing as a Full-Stack and Front-End UI Developer. I have a proven track record of architecting, maintaining, and scaling complex web applications — including managing a 2.5M+ line monorepo across 32+ microservices — and driving innovation through GenAI, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows. Currently pursuing an M.Tech in AI & Data Science at IIT Patna.

projects.name: Client Outreach — Sales Orchestration Platform

projects.name: Snapfish — Global E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: Engineered and optimized the micro-frontend 'cart-app' checkout component deployed across 11 countries. Led jQuery-to-React migration with 100% backward compatibility and built POC solutions for security hardening and performance.

projects.name: Bronte — Pearson Education Portal
projects.description: Developed interactive React modules — Knowledge Maps, Publishing systems, and Schema Editors. Built serverless backend logic with Node.js and AWS Lambda. Resolved WCAG accessibility compliance issues across the platform.

projects.name: Grange Insurance Portal

projects.name: Campus CMS
projects.description: Developed, tested, and scaled a CMS with role-based access control and multi-tiered permissions. Executed platform migrations, resolved production issues, and trained team members in ES6 and enterprise Java practices.

items.title: Prompt Engineering for LLMs
items.author: John Berryman & Albert Ziegler
items.description: The art and science of building Large Language Model-based applications — covers prompt design patterns, chain-of-thought, tool use, and practical LLM integration strategies for production systems.

items.title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
items.author: Martin Kleppmann
items.description: The definitive deep-dive into data systems — covering replication, partitioning, transactions, and stream processing at scale. Essential reading for any engineer owning distributed infrastructure.

items.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
items.author: Lewis et al. — Meta AI Research
items.description: The foundational RAG paper combining parametric and non-parametric memory for open-domain QA. Directly shaped how I design RAG pipelines in production.

items.title: Building Microservices
items.author: Sam Newman
items.description: End-to-end guide for designing fine-grained microservice architectures with practical patterns for inter-service communication, deployment, and resilience.

items.title: Attention Is All You Need
items.author: Vaswani et al. — Google Brain
items.description: The transformer paper that underpins every modern LLM. Understanding the self-attention mechanism is foundational to all GenAI engineering.

items.title: Efficient Large Language Models: A Survey
items.author: Wan et al.
items.description: Comprehensive survey of techniques for making LLMs more efficient — quantization, pruning, distillation, and SLMs. Exploring for cost-efficient AWS GenAI deployments.

items.name: This Portfolio

items.name: RAG Playground
items.description: An experimental sandbox for testing Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines with different chunking strategies, embedding models, and retrieval algorithms. Built to accelerate my applied GenAI research.

items.name: Coding Coach
items.description: A tool that helps anyone improve their coding skills by solving one question slightly harder than their current level. It uses a custom algorithm to select questions based on user performance and provides hints and explanations for each problem.
